test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: The total number of Ministers, including the Chief Minister, in the Council of Ministers in a State CANNOT exceed ________ of the total number of members of the Legislative Assembly of that State.
solution:
The correct answer is** __15%.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Modification to **Article 164. (1A)- A State's Council of Ministers** may not have more than **15% of its membership **made up of Ministers, including the **Chief Minister.**
 
• According to the constitution, a **state's council of ministers** must have a minimum of **12 members and a maximum of 15% **of the Legislative Assembly. Without the council of ministers, the president of India would not have had a **governor (during the president's tenure).**

 
• The** Indian Constitution stipulates** that a State Legislative Assembly must consist of at least 60 and no more than 500 individuals. The states of **Goa, Sikkim, Mizoram, and the union territory of Puducherry**, all of which have fewer than 60 members, are examples of exceptions made by an **Act of Parliament.**
 
• **Article 158 of the Indian Constitution stipulates** that the Legislative Assembly must have between 60 and 500 members. The largest state, Uttar Pradesh, has **403 representatives in its assembly. **
 
• The **First Sikkim Assembly,** which had 32 members when it was elected in 1974, is regarded as Sikkim's first duly elected legislature under the Indian Constitution. 32 seats in all were allocated, with 15 seats reserved for **Sikkimese-born Nepalis** and one seat set aside for the **Sangha. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​By 2022, a **state legislative council **will be established in** six of the 28 states**. Andhra Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Karnataka, Telangana, Maharashtra, and Bihar are **among them.**
 
• The **State Legislature's two chambers **are referred to as the Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad) and the Legislative Assembly, respectively. The **State Legislature's single** house is known as the **Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) (Vidhan Sabha).**
 
• A** speaker is in charge of each legislative assembly** in the Lok Sabha, the twenty-eight states, and the three union territories.
 
• There is a chairperson who also serves as the leader of the **Rajya Sabha and the legislative council **in each of the six states with an upper house of the** state legislature. **
